subject: Action Required: E-Billing XML Spec + Tax Residency for APAC Distributor
messages:
From: Maria Ferreira To: Michael Grant Cc: finance@oceanic-dist.com Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 08:12:00 -0500 Subject: E-billing XML & supplier tax residency info for Redwood POs Hi Michael, Thanks for the walkthrough last week. To complete Oceanic Distribution's vendor setup for Redwood, our AP team attached two files: a sample invoice in your e-billing XML layout and our completed Supplier Tax Residency Declaration (PDF). A few open items from our side where we need confirmation from Redwood before we accept the PO and route invoices into our e-invoice system: - Do you require the XML to include both our local tax ID (BR CNPJ / AU ABN / NZ IRD depending on ship-to) and a global vendor id? - For Australia shipments: will Redwood apply reverse-charge (GST) on vendor bills, or should we invoice with local GST where applicable? - Preferred PO currency: we can invoice in local currency or USD — please confirm which lane Redwood expects for cross-border distributor partner POs. - Any specific field mapping required for the and nodes? Attaching: sample_invoice_xml.xml, supplier_tax_residency_form.pdf (scanned). We'd like to get this closed by Friday so our billing cutover can align with your next monthly PO batch. Best, Maria Ferreira Head of Finance, Oceanic Distribution Ltd maria.ferreira@oceanic-dist.com +61 3 9000 1234 --- From: Michael Grant To: Maria Ferreira Cc: Laura Bennett , Ben Carter Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -0500 Subject: Re: E-billing XML & supplier tax residency info for Redwood POs Hi Maria — thanks for the attachments and clear list. Looping in Laura (APAC procurement) and Ben (tax ops) so we can confirm mappings and tax treatment. Quick responses / next steps: 1) ID requirements: We need local tax ID in the invoice (e.g., AU ABN, BR CNPJ) and our vendor_uid field populated. We'll accept vendor_uid either as your internal GUID or the HubSpot company id — reach out if you prefer a different token. 2) Australia GST: Ben — can you confirm whether Redwood will accept supplier-charged GST from registered ANZ vendors vs applying reverse-charge? My read: for distributors registered to collect GST we should accept supplier-charged GST (i.e., process invoice with taxes). For services in some cases reverse-charge may apply. 3) PO currency: Our standard cross-border lane prefers USD for partner POs unless the vendor requests local currency AND we create an explicit FX clause on the PO. Maria, if you prefer USD, we can issue POs in USD. 4) XML mapping: Laura, I've uploaded a short mapping doc to Drive (link below) — can you validate the and fields against Oceanic's sample? Action items: - Maria: please confirm preferred PO currency and provide the local tax registration number(s) to populate invoice fields. - Laura: validate XML mapping and confirm whether we need an additional block for EU-like fiscal agents. - Ben: advise on reverse-charge vs supplier GST rules for AU/NZ/BR (and any withholding tax that might affect our AP routing). Drive links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3EbillingSpec I aim to have the PO lane configured by EOD Thu if we get the completed residency form + tax IDs. Thanks, Michael Michael Grant Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference From: Laura Bennett To: Michael Grant , Ben Carter Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 09:22:00 -0500 Subject: Fwd: E-billing XML & supplier tax residency info for Redwood POs Michael / Ben — quick internal note after reviewing Oceanic's sample XML (attached here). Observations: - sample_invoice_xml.xml includes a with separate entries per jurisdiction (good). We should map our internal tax_code to /code and keep amount/percent in cents to avoid locale decimal issues. - Oceanic included a node for service line items with attribute scheme="WTH". Suggest we map Redwood's withholding_flag to that node and only populate when their country confirms WHT applies. - For Brazil (CNPJ): their sample omits municipal taxes (ISS). Ben, do we need ISS-level handling for our services purchases? If not, we can defer. Proposed short XML snippet for our ingestion (for APAC):
{vendor_uid} {tax_id} {currency}
{tax_code} {amount} Questions for Ben (please): - Confirm whether Redwood prefers to net withholding amounts off PO gross or to accept full gross and process tax credits post-payment. - Confirm whether reverse-charge for AU services (digital/saas) should be treated as supplier-exempt on our side (i.e., no GST on invoice) or if we should expect supplier to charge GST. I'll prepare the mapping doc and a small validation script for their sample by EOD and share via Drive. If we get Maria's confirmation on currency + tax IDs today, we can do a test invoice ingestion on Thu. Thanks, Laura Bennett Procurement Lead, APAC, Redwood Inference --- On Mon, Nov 3, 2025 at 10:05 AM Michael Grant wrote: > Hi Maria — thanks for the attachments and clear list. Looping in Laura (APAC procurement) and Ben (tax ops) so we can confirm mappings and tax treatment. From: Maria Ferreira To: Michael Grant Cc: finance@oceanic-dist.com Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -0500 Subject: Re: E-billing XML & supplier tax residency info for Redwood POs Thanks Michael / Laura — answers below and a couple clarifications. - Preferred PO currency: USD. Please issue POs in USD for cross-border shipments; we'll accept USD invoices. - Tax IDs: AU ABN: 51 634 295 482; BR CNPJ: 12.345.678/0001-90. We'll include the appropriate ID in each invoice header depending on ship-to country. - GST / Reverse-charge: Oceanic is GST-registered in AU and will charge GST on goods sold in AU (we understand Redwood's stance to accept supplier-charged GST where the supplier is registered). For service-type invoices that reference Redwood-managed SaaS in AU, we can leave tax lines blank and accept guidance on reverse-charge. - Withholding: For Brazil services there may be local withholding depending on line item; we'll flag with when applicable. Attached is the completed supplier_tax_residency_form.pdf (signed) and an updated sample_invoice_xml.xml that includes vendor_uid and currency=USD. Timeline: if Redwood can confirm mapping and perform a test ingest on Thu (Nov 6), we can go live for the next PO batch on Mon Nov 9. Let me know if you need any further certification or a scanned certificate of GST registration for Australia. Best, Maria Head of Finance, Oceanic Distribution Ltd
